What is the customer support email?: You can contact our loan customer support team at loansupport@abclending.com.
What is the customer support phone numbe: You can call our toll-free customer support helpline at 1800-102-2233.
What is the customer support hours?: Our customer support team is available from Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
Where is the corporate office?: Our corporate head office is located at ABC Lending Towers, Connaught Place, New Delhi - 110001.
What are the branch working hours?: Our branches are open Monday to Friday from 9:30 AM to 4:00 PM, and on the 1st, 3rd, and 5th Saturdays of the month.
Is branch closed on 2nd and 4th Saturday: Yes, in accordance with banking regulations, all our branches are closed on the 2nd and 4th Saturdays of every month.
Who is the Nodal Officer?: Our Principal Nodal Officer is Mr. Ramesh Sharma, reachable at nodalofficer@abclending.com for unresolved grievances.
How do I submit a complaint?: You can log a complaint online through our grievance portal, send an email to support, or visit any branch and write in the complaint register.
What is the toll free helpline?: Our national toll-free customer care number is 1800-102-2233, available for all retail loan inquiries.
How long does complaint resolution take?: We aim to resolve all standard customer complaints within 7 to 10 working days from the date of submission.
Can I check my complaint status?: Yes, you can track your complaint status using the ticket reference ID sent to your registered mobile number.
Who is the Banking Ombudsman?: If your complaint is not resolved by our Nodal Officer within 30 days, you can escalate it to the RBI Banking Ombudsman.
What is the customer care number for NRI: NRI customers can call our dedicated international support desk at +91-11-44556677.
Can I apply for a loan through customer: No, customer care can guide you through the process, but applications must be submitted online or at the branch.
How do I update my registered mobile num: To update your mobile number, visit your nearest branch with an identity proof and submit a mobile update request form.
How do I update my email address?: You can update your email address through our Net Banking portal or by visiting any branch.
Where can I find the nearest branch?: You can find your nearest branch using the Locator tool on our official website or by sharing your pin code with me.
What is the address of CP branch?: Our CP branch is located at G-Block, Outer Circle, Connaught Place, New Delhi - 110001.
Do you have a branch in Mumbai?: Yes, our main Mumbai branch is located at Nariman Point, Mumbai - 400021.
Do you have a branch in Bangalore?: Yes, our main Bangalore branch is located at MG Road, Bangalore - 560001.
What is the customer portal URL?: You can access the loan customer portal at https://loans.abclending.com to view your account details.
How do I download my loan statement?: Log in to the loan customer portal, select your active loan account, and click on 'Download Statement of Account'.
How do I get an interest certificate?: You can download your provisional or final interest certificate from the customer portal or request one via email support.
What is the charges for issuing interest: We issue the annual interest certificate free of charge to all active loan accounts.
Is there a charge for updating address?: No, updating your address in our records is a free service, subject to Aadhaar or passport validation.
